Message:
I...always wanted to fly.
Just like Mother and Brother,
spreading my wings freely
in the great sky above...

I gave up though,
thinking flight was
impossible for me,
since I never grew wings.

Nestlings don’t fly because
somebody told them to.
They fly because they want to.

Someone like me, who only
ever looks at the sky waiting
for something to change,
could never fly...

But, now I know...
Why you pushed me
out of the nest, Mother...

You were teaching me
how to fly, weren’t you...?

You were telling me to have
the courage to live my own life—
to spread my wings and fly...

It’s time for me to leave the nest.
Yes...because now, I...!

As I leapt forward,
everyone stopped
in their tracks.

“Y-You rotten witch!
Just what are you
trying to pull...?!”

No matter what I may be,
I’m still Mother’s daughter.

That’s the answer I’ve come to...
for who I really am...!
